note: Small family-owned RV park among cotton fields at 623 Bullard Rd, Baxley, near Plant Hatch; it markets itself to outage, seasonal and contract workers and long-term stays as well as travelers on US-1. Up to six covered spaces; dog park, fire pit (firewood included). --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 22 full-hookup pull-through sites (30/50 A), laundry, WiFi, $40 daily (weekly $160). Booking is by phone (every Book Now button goes to the contact page; no RoverPass listing exists), so platform set to phone; cleared the aggregator-derived 80-ft max length. Google Maps: 4.9 stars / 68 reviews, phone 912-240-0099 matches. Note trimmed of hookups/sites/rates/booking (and the RoverPass claim). No gateway within 40 km (Savannah 124 km); no family stay; $40 is under the gate.
